content.user_title: Optimize Marketing Pages for More Conversions
content.value_statement: Marketing pages often lose conversions through unclear messaging, weak calls to action, and avoidable friction. This skill provides prioritized audits, copy alternatives, and test ideas.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates value propositions, headlines, calls to action, visual hierarchy, trust signals, objections, and friction.
Adapts recommendations for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, blog posts, and marketing forms.
Organizes recommendations into quick wins, high-impact changes, test ideas, and copy alternatives.
Suggests page-specific experiments for messaging, layout, pricing, social proof, navigation, and conversion paths.
Audits form fields, layouts, validation messages, mobile behavior, submit states, and measurement plans.
limitations: It cannot verify a live page unless the user supplies accessible page content or visual evidence.
It cannot predict conversion lift without controlled tests and reliable analytics.
It does not implement experiments, analytics tracking, or production page changes.
Signup flows, onboarding, popups, and full copy rewrites may require related specialist skills.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a landing page
use_cases.description: Find conversion barriers, improve message match, and prioritize changes for paid or organic campaign traffic.

use_cases.title: Improve pricing decisions
use_cases.description: Clarify plan differences, reduce selection anxiety, and develop experiments for pricing presentation and trust signals.

use_cases.title: Reduce form abandonment
use_cases.description: Review field requirements, layout, validation, mobile usability, and submit behavior for lead or contact forms.

prompt_templates.title: Review a homepage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this homepage for conversion barriers. Our main goal is [goal], and traffic comes from [source]. Give me quick wins first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit with a clear goal and traffic source

prompt_templates.title: Audit a landing page
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this landing page using the CRO framework. Prioritize issues by impact and effort. Provide three headline options and three CTA options.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a pricing page
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this pricing page and our conversion data. Explain why visitors avoid [plan]. Recommend clearer positioning, objection handling, and five test hypotheses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Pricing choice and plan differentiation analysis

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a conversion decline
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these previous and current page versions. Identify likely causes of the conversion decline. Rank evidence, reversible fixes, and controlled experiments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced regression diagnosis using page versions and analytics

output_examples.input: Our landing page gets paid traffic but few visitors start a free trial.
output_examples.output: Quick Wins: Match the headline to the advertisement promise and make the trial CTA specific. High-Impact Change: Add product evidence beside the primary CTA. Test Idea: Compare the revised message against the current page.

output_examples.input: Most buyers choose our cheapest plan, while the middle plan receives little attention.
output_examples.output: Priority Issue: The middle plan lacks a distinct outcome and clear audience. Recommendation: Define its best-fit customer and emphasize exclusive value. Test Idea: Compare stronger differentiation with a recommended-plan treatment.

output_examples.input: Visitors abandon our demo request form before submission.
output_examples.output: Form Audit: Remove fields that sales does not use and make the phone field optional. Mobile Fix: Use one column and appropriate keyboards. Measurement: Track field completion, errors, and abandonment by device.

best_practices: Provide the page type, primary conversion goal, traffic source, current conversion rate, and available research.
Share page content, screenshots, analytics, and recent changes so recommendations can cite visible evidence.
Treat recommendations as hypotheses and validate important changes with controlled experiments.
anti_patterns: Do not request generic advice without sharing the page, audience, offer, or conversion goal.
Do not apply every recommendation at once because combined changes prevent reliable learning.
Do not present estimated conversion gains as guaranteed results.

faq.question: Which pages can this skill review?
faq.answer: It covers homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, blog posts, lead forms, contact forms, and similar marketing experiences.

faq.question: Does it need access to a live URL?
faq.answer: No. You can provide page copy, screenshots, a structured description, or accessible page content.

faq.question: Can it optimize signup or onboarding flows?
faq.answer: It can identify general friction, but dedicated signup and onboarding skills provide more specific guidance.

faq.question: Will the recommendations guarantee higher conversions?
faq.answer: No. Recommendations are evidence-based hypotheses that require analytics and controlled testing.

faq.question: What information improves the audit?
faq.answer: Share the conversion goal, traffic source, audience, current rate, page evidence, device mix, and previous tests.

faq.question: Can it create test ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It proposes page-specific hypotheses for messaging, calls to action, social proof, layout, pricing, forms, and navigation.
